description: CRUXEval-I style: given three small Python functions and their outputs, reason backwards to the unique input of each (sum of squared digits plus first and last digit packed into one number, a reversed case-marking encoder, and a modular rolling hash over a strictly increasing 4-tuple). Uniqueness under the stated constraint was verified by brute force. The final single ANSWER line is pinned by one regex; running the code to search for the inputs is forbidden by the prompt and checked through tool_invoked absent.
